<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.56.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* [feat] Allow specifying number of visible items via `expanded` in `st.navigation` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14051
* [feat] Add `on_click` rerun support to `st.link_button` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14116
* [feature] Add file type shortcuts for `st.file_uploader` and `st.chat_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14140
* Allow programmatically setting `st.dataframe` selections by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13594
* [feat] Extract leading icon from alert body by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14173
* [feat] Serve static files with native content types by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14090
* feat: allow external URLs in st.Page for navigation sidebar  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13691
* [feat] Add `AudioColumn` and `VideoColumn` to `st.column_config` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14032
* [feat] Add `st.menu_button` widget by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13981
* [feature] Add `hide_index` and `hide_header` to `st.table` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14113
* [feature] Add `height` parameter to `st.chat_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14165
* [feature] Add `st.file_uploader` support to AppTest by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14341
* [feature] Always show the dataframe column visibility menu by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14336
* [feature] Add support for relative static file serving URLs in media elements by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14317
* [feature] Add `alignment` parameter to `column_config` columns by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14333
* [feat] Complete incomplete markdown syntax during streaming by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13939
* [feature] Stable Block.id for passive keyed layout containers by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14330
* [feature] `st.tabs` state persistence and CSS key class by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14332
* [feature] `st.expander` & `st.popover` state persistence and CSS key class by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14356
* [feature] Add `required` parameter to `st.pills` and `st.segmented_control` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14414
* Add support for pandas 3.x by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13812
* [feature] Add `single-row-required` selection mode to `st.dataframe` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14288
* [feature] Add `autoscroll` parameter to `st.container` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14502
* [feature] Add filter mode to select widgets by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14537
* [feature] Add `st.iframe` command by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14433
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [fix] Allow running streamlit with python optimization by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14171
* [Fix] Fix `st.text_area` `height="content"` not working by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14228
* Fix stale anchor preserved when clearing transient nodes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14251
* fix(testing): initialize BidiComponentManager in AppTest mock runtime by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14301
* [fix] Python 3.14 PEP 649 annotation compatibility across `inspect.signature()` calls by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14327
* [fix] Restore tooltip on st.multiselect selected options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14353
* [fix] Restore reactJsonViewCompat shim for local dev server by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14391
* [Fix] Restore bound query params in URL with MPA by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14374
* [fix] st.exception links overflow at small widths by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14417
* [fix] Remove heading padding in horizontal containers for proper alignment by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14419
* [fix] Streaming markdown with color directives shows artifact by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14468
* [fix] Add Windows stability check to file watcher to reduce false positives by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14174
* Fix #11308: update server.port after binding to port 0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14372
* [fix] Add border to main menu in dark mode by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14529
* [Fix] OpenMetrics compliance for `session_duration` metric by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14476
* Fix programmatic dataframe selections to return AttributeDictionary by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14455
### Other Changes
* [refactor] Log widget state duplication warning to console instead of UI by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14141
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14186
* Update protobuf requirement from <7,>=3.20 to >=3.20,<8 in /lib by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14213
* [chore] Release v1.55.0 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14203
* refactor(ccv2): rename BidiComponentResult to ComponentResult by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14253
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14282
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14395
* Docs for `st.navigation` `expanded` parameter by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14451
* Docs for new file uploader types by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14453
* Docs for `st.link_button` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14452
* Docs for auto-extracting icons by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14458
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14482
* Docs for menu button by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14495
* Docs for table hide options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14497
* Docs for URL pages and navigation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14480
* Docs for chat input height by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14499
* Add key-value list example for `st.table` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14474
* [Fix] Make `_stcore/metrics` OpenMetrics-compliant by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14538
